name: FLIGHT
subtitle: Direction becomes form.
lead: FLIGHT studies collective movement, lift, migration and radial flow. The butterfly is not used as decoration; its directional logic becomes a field that can occupy an atrium, orbit a table, climb a stair or mark an arrival.
principles: Optical modules rather than literal figures
Architectural suspension as part of the composition
status: VORTEX is the implemented engineering programme. Other FLIGHT works are concept studies.

name: OCEAN
subtitle: Movement without machinery.
lead: OCEAN translates current, eddy, schooling and caustic behaviour into optical bodies. The ambition is to make a static object feel continuously in motion because light changes as it passes through thickness, curvature and the viewer's position.
status: CURRENT 01 is an exploratory optical-body study, not a construction-release fixture.

name: BOTANICA
subtitle: Growth becomes illumination.
lead: BOTANICA looks at the intelligence inside living structures: venation, branching, overlapping growth and transport networks. Instead of copying a leaf or flower silhouette, the collection turns those systems into internal paths of light.
principles: Scalable wall, pendant and object typologies
status: VEIN 01 is an optical and typology study. Material and extraction behaviour require physical prototyping.

name: CELESTIAL
subtitle: Light organised by orbit and occlusion.
lead: CELESTIAL studies orbit, eclipse, alignment and apparent depth. Rings, arcs and translucent bodies overlap to create compositions that change from one viewpoint to the next without relying on decorative complexity.
principles: Warm reflection balanced with optical transparency
status: SOLARA 02 is used here as an exploratory orbit study while the CELESTIAL collection language is being defined.

name: ABSTRACT MOTION
subtitle: Perception becomes movement.
lead: ABSTRACT MOTION is the collection for phenomena that do not need a biological motif: phase shift, tension, layered fields, falling rhythm and optical interference. Movement can be physical, perceptual or simply implied by geometry.
principles: Tension and force as form generators
Large spatial fields rather than conventional chandeliers
status: The collection remains exploratory. LUMINA 03 is presented as a spatial-field study rather than a released product.
